technical_details.root_cause: Integer truncation on packet frame header parsing in parse_frame_header() function leading to undersized buffer allocation followed by unchecked memcpy() of payload data.
technical_details.exploit_vector: Remote network exploitation via listening port 8443. Threat actors transmit malformed fragmented JSON payloads to trigger memory corruption and achieve arbitrary root execution.

mitigation_status.workaround_details: Customer advisory ADV-2026-0042 published via secure portal on 2026-10-13T13:00:00Z recommending immediate firewall blocking of port 8443 on external interfaces.

sensitivity_grading.distribution_restriction: Restricted strictly to CSIRT-IE, ENISA, and designated CSIRTs of affected Member States (DE, FR, NL).
